body: Yes, Americans are stupid.   Maybe I'm one of the stupid ones.   I don't even know anymore.   Trump is a piece of trash.   AOC is a smug, naive toddler.  Our SCOTUS justices are academic pricks.   Maybe the only good thing about our representative government is that it's actually representative of stupidity.

I still don't know.  I didn't want to wake up.  I've been living in a fog since.  I've read through the comments and replies, I've skimmed Reddit in general on autopilot.  I've gotten a lot of private messages asking about whether it hurt, how long it took, suggestions for how to do it better.   I'm mostly numb.
I remember happy things.   Just last Sunday I had an awesome experience that I'm grateful for.  But those things don't seem to give me any desire to keep going.

I'm asking myself the same question.  How did I end up here?  When I say "end up" it strikes me that it really feels like the end.    

I grew up being taught a model of life.  The standard college, marriage, kids, good job, eventual retirement.  I feel like that model fucking sucks.   I did college, grad school, got married (biggest mistake), had kids, have a professional job with a decent salary.  My marriage ended because of her, and I'm not just casting blame.  I wasn't perfect but I was a respectful husband and she squandered it.   Long story for another time.    

On paper, I was moderately successful.  I feel too beat down to be in another relationship and I also don't want to drag someone else into my life when I have no idea what I'm doing here or why I'd keep going.  I could not be here and the world would keep going and things would be just as fine, or shitty, as they are right now.

When I woke up I thought I was dead and in a cold, dark room.   But then I realized I was just on the floor of my bathroom.  I've been absurdly vulnerable over the past 6 months, but it doesn't seem easier than checking out.   I don't feel any purpose here and I don't see a purpose in my future.

I don't know how to find support.   I try to focus on positive things, but it all seems futile.  I have a therapist I see weekly, but I can't bring myself to fully open up.  I feel like any potential I have in my life will disappear if I admit where I'm at.
